description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Weerasekara Mudiyanselage Harsha Kumara Weerasekara as a member of the Kundasale P/S. reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance regarding vacancies in Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies) due to members ceasing party membership, and the filling of a vacancy through nomination by a political party.
